messages:
emma: FYI nightly e2e perf gate went red for longseq run — p99 jumped ~2.1x and mixedseq throughput dropped ~18%. dashboard: https://perf.redwood.dev/d/longseq/nightly (looks like 03:12 UTC)
ci-bot: Job failed: nightly-e2e-longseq #2845 — p99: 310ms (baseline 145ms), throughput: 820 rps (baseline 1000 rps). Artifacts: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/2845.
raj: ack — grabbing logs. any recent config changes to batching/scheduler?
matt: pushed batching scheduler tweak yesterday (PR 487) that changes max_batch_delay semantics. I reverted locally and ran a small smoke — didn't reproduce but didn't run full longseq.
sophia: can we rerun the nightly job with the previous scheduler flag? quick repro would help decide bisect vs config rollback.
emma: yeah can we 1) rerun nightly with BATCH_DELAY_MS=0 (force immediate flush) and 2) run canary longseq on a single node with the failing docker image sha `ab12cdef`?
raj: rerun queued: `ci rerun nightly-e2e-longseq --build 2845 --env BATCH_DELAY_MS=0` — kicked off as #2846. will ping when results. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ci-bot: Rerun started: nightly-e2e-longseq #2846. ETA ~25m.
matt: if #2846 still fails we should bisect PR 487 range. I can take git-bisect if someone narrows the commit window.
sophia: quick check: could kvcache behavior change explain throughput? recent kv prefetch change in runtime 0.9.2 (commit d3f9) touched eviction thresholds. worth adding a run with KV_PREFETCH=false too.
emma: good call — raj can you add KV_PREFETCH=false to the rerun set if #2846 fails?
raj: noted. also pulling flame graphs now from artifact bundle. snippet from tail of logs:
```
2026-03-15T03:11:58Z [runner] seq=1024 p99_latency=312ms tokens/s=185
2026-03-15T03:12:12Z [batcher] flush_time=18ms batch_size=6
2026-03-15T03:12:12Z [runtime] kv_cache.hit_rate=0.61 model_forward_ms=24
```
raj: hit rate dropped vs baseline (0.86) — suggests caching regressed on these sequences.
emma: ok if #2846 still red we'll ask matt to bisect 487 and i can start a controlled canary matrix varying BATCH_DELAY_MS and KV_PREFETCH. plan: 3 canary runs per config, abort if p99>200ms or throughput <900 rps.
matt: happy to bisect — please list commit bounds. I think start = commit before PR 487 (sha f1e2) end = tip of main at time of merge (sha a9b0).
sophia: pinging @oncall (for capacity) if this becomes an incident. otherwise this stays triage. :eyes:
ci-bot: Rerun finished: nightly-e2e-longseq #2846 — still failed. p99: 305ms, throughput: 835 rps.
emma: thanks. matt — please start bisect on [f1e2..a9b0]. raj/sophia — kick off canary matrix: configs = [{BATCH_DELAY_MS=0, KV_PREFETCH=true}, {BATCH_DELAY_MS=8, KV_PREFETCH=false}]. report back with earliest green.
raj: starting canary runs now with small cluster. I'll attach links when done.
matt: starting git bisect now. will report first bad commit within a couple hours. :hammer_and_wrench:
emma: awesome — keep updates in this thread. if bisect narrows to a single change we can revert or patch fast. :thumbsup:
